headline: Why Strike CEO Calls Coldcard Wallet Drain ‘One Of The Most Serious’ Bitcoin Hacks
summary: The hackers used an “automated tool” to scan 1,196 wallets and steal more than 1,082 BTC within just 41 minutes.
